description: Shape software requirements into documented architecture decisions.

defaultPrompt: Help me turn this product brief into architecture requirements and open questions.
Compare two system designs with trade-offs, assumptions, and failure modes.
Draft an architecture decision record for this choice.
interface.longDescription: Explore software requirements and constraints, compare architecture options, and document system designs and decisions. Address security, reliability, scalability, operability, and cost trade-offs while clearly labeling assumptions. Provides advisory artifacts only; implementation, verification, and production changes require separate tools and accountable human review.

name: software-architect
